name: Tractor and farm machinery dealers and rental

problems.words: Customers booked tractors and delivery is months late, they keep calling
quick_ideas: Put every booking in one list by booking date with its expected delivery, so you can answer calls from facts
Send each waiting customer one honest status update.

workzap_build.text: A booking queue that tracks every booking from advance to delivery and sends customers WhatsApp status updates whenever things change.

problems.ask_first: Roughly how many bookings are waiting right now?
problems.free_stops: How the queue and status updates are set up goes in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many booked tractors are past their promised arrival by branch or model, so you see where the calling pressure is heaviest.
Give one staff member the waiting-booking list and a fixed daily update time, so callers hear the same status without interrupting everyone.

problems.words: Rental harvester sits idle one week and is double-booked the next
quick_ideas: Put every machine's bookings on one shared calendar, so clashes and gaps are visible
Take bookings through one person only during peak season.

workzap_build.text: A rental fleet calendar with each machine's bookings, location and status, blocking double bookings and showing idle days.

problems.ask_first: How many machines do you rent out?
problems.free_stops: Calendar rules and the utilisation view are part of the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare each harvester's booked days against days actually worked this week, so idle gaps and clash periods show up together.
Give one person the job of writing every booking and completion in one place each evening, so machine time stops being guessed.

problems.words: Operator says he did 40 acres, the farmer says 30
quick_ideas: Ask operators to send a WhatsApp message with photo when each job ends, so there is a record at the time
Get the farmer to confirm the area in that same message thread.

workzap_build.text: An operator job log with location check-in, acres or hours, photos and the farmer's WhatsApp confirmation, for every job.

problems.free_stops: How jobs are logged and confirmed is detailed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note each completed field job with the operator's acreage and the farmer's acreage on the same page, so disputed work is easy to spot.
Give one office person the job of collecting both acreage notes before any bill is raised, so arguments are caught before cash collection.

problems.words: Operators take cash from farmers directly and don't hand it all in
quick_ideas: Ask farmers to pay into one account or to the office where possible, so less cash moves through operators
Match every job against money handed in at week end.

workzap_build.text: A daily match of each operator's jobs against cash handed in or received, flagging gaps by machine.

problems.ask_first: Do farmers mostly pay the operator or the office?
problems.free_stops: How jobs and collections are matched goes in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare jobs completed this week with cash handed in for those same jobs, so short handovers show where money slips away.
Make one office person receive all operator handovers at a fixed evening time in one notebook, so missing cash is noticed the same day.

problems.words: Diesel use on rental machines doesn't add up
quick_ideas: Record every fill with machine and hour reading for one week, so fills can be checked against work done
Have one person authorise all fills.

workzap_build.text: A diesel log per machine set against hours and acres, flagging fills that don't fit the work done.

problems.ask_first: Who fills diesel for the rental machines?
problems.free_stops: The matching rules are kept for the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count diesel fills for each rental machine beside its hours worked this week, so the worst mismatches stand out fast.
Give one staff member the job of writing every fill in one notebook before the machine leaves, so fuel questions come back to one record.

problems.words: Machine breaks down in the field during peak harvest
quick_ideas: Note each machine's hours and last service date on one list, so the most overdue get attention before the season
Keep the commonly failing parts in stock ahead of peak.

workzap_build.text: A maintenance schedule by machine hours with service-due alerts, and a breakdown history per machine.

problems.ask_first: Do you service the fleet yourselves?
problems.free_stops: How service schedules and alerts are set for your fleet goes in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count field breakdowns by machine during the last busy week, so you see which units are causing the harvest delays.
Give one person a fixed evening check of machine hours and overdue services in one notebook, so peak-season downtime gets less surprise.

problems.words: Parts counter runs out of fast-moving filters and belts
quick_ideas: List the parts you ran out of in the last season, so you know which ones matter
Set a minimum shelf level for those few and check it weekly.

workzap_build.text: Parts stock with minimum levels, sending you reorder alerts when stock runs low, with parts issued only against job cards.

problems.ask_first: Roughly how many parts lines do you carry?
problems.free_stops: Minimum levels and the issue process are set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note every time the counter could not supply a filter or belt this week, so the parts hurting sales are plain.
Give one counter person one notebook for out-of-stock notes at closing time, so reordering stops relying on rushed conversations.

problems.words: Instalment customers fall behind after a bad harvest
quick_ideas: List every instalment due this month and who is late, so follow-up is planned rather than reactive
Contact late customers early and politely; for terms or repossession questions, talk to your lawyer.

workzap_build.text: An instalment and rental receivables tracker with ageing and reminder messages before and after each due date.

problems.ask_first: Do you finance instalments yourselves or through a third party?
problems.free_stops: Reminder timing and the tracker setup are part of the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many instalments due this week were not received on time, so the size of the collection problem is clear.
Give one person one overdue list and a fixed follow-up hour each day, so late accounts get attention before excuses pile up.

problems.words: Enquiries from Facebook and PakWheels never get followed up
quick_ideas: Write every enquiry into one list with the date and where it came from, so none is lost
Give one salesperson the job of calling back each day.

workzap_build.text: A lead tracker that pulls enquiries from WhatsApp, Facebook and listing sites and reminds salespeople to follow up on time.

problems.ask_first: Where do most enquiries come from now?
problems.free_stops: How enquiries are captured and followed up is detailed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count new enquiries and compare them with callbacks made the same day, so missed sales attention is easy to see.
Give one salesperson one notebook for every incoming enquiry and a fixed callback hour, so leads stop getting buried under daily shop noise.

problems.words: I can't see which branch sells and which only eats cost
quick_ideas: Put one month of units sold, rental, workshop and parts income per branch side by side
Add each branch's main costs to the same sheet.

workzap_build.text: You would see sales, rental use, workshop revenue, parts and outstanding amounts for each branch every day.

problems.ask_first: How many branches and workshops do you have?
problems.free_stops: What we measure for your business is kept for the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count tractors sold, rentals started, workshop jobs closed and parts bills written at each branch this week, so weak branches stand out clearly.
Give one person at each branch a fixed end-of-day note for those four counts in one notebook, so head office compares branches without chasing.

never_say: Advice on repair procedures, safety modifications, removing guards or technical specs.
Advice on financing, interest, leasing law, instalment law, repossession, registration, tax or import duties.
Any agronomy advice on field operations.
Any help tampering with hour meters, forging registration or import papers, passing used machines off as new or avoiding customs duty.
Encouraging "own money" premiums; recording customers', operators' or guarantors' names, CNICs or licence numbers.

sample_reply.person: Hamare 6 harvester kiraye pe chalte hain. Driver acre zyada batate hain aur paisa kam aata hai, iska kya hal hai?
sample_reply.pi:
Haan, is par kaam ho sakta hai, aur is ke liye bade kharch ki zaroorat nahi.
Pehle, har kaam khatam hote hi driver se WhatsApp pe photo ke saath acre ka paigham mangwayein, aur kisan se usi thread mein tasdeeq le lein, taake waqt pe record ban jaaye.
Doosra, hafte ke aakhir mein har machine ke kaam ko jama hue paise se mila lein.
Workzap ye tarteeb de sakta hai: har kaam ka location, acre, tasdeeq aur wasooli roz darj ho aur farq pe alert aaye.

Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
